question: National Sports University is situated in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manipur**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The National Sports University (NSU) is located in Imphal, Manipur: 
 
• The university is currently operating from its temporary campus at the Khuman Lampak Sports Complex in Imphal. 
 
• It is about 10 kilometres from the Imphal airport. 
 
• Prime Minister Narendra Modi laid the foundation stone for the university on March 16, 2018. 
 
• It also has a new campus under construction in the West District of Manipur that will include sports infrastructure, academic and administrative blocks, a library, auditorium, conference hall, and hostels
